name: Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk
armament: 7.62 mm M240 or M134 door guns
protection: Armoured crew seats. Game: airframe is not armoured against heavy MGs; 7.62x54R and larger damage it, 12.7/14.5 mm and MANPADS bring it down; small-calibre rounds only to cockpit glass if the game enables that.
visual_notes: Medium helicopter with tapered fuselage and canted tail rotor
Medium-lift helicopter with tapered fuselage and wide cabin doors
Canted tail rotor on the right, horizontal stabiliser at the tail base
4-blade main rotor; door guns on window mounts
